ValidationRule.description: Non-draft budgets of 10k+ must be whole thousands, completion must move in 5% steps, and approved spend must be whole dollars.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft')), OR( AND(Budget__c >= 10000, MOD(MFLOOR(Budget__c), 1000) <> 0), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Completion_Pct__c)), MOD(ROUND(Completion_Pct__c * 100, 0), 5) <> 0), AND(Is_Approved__c, NOT(ISBLANK(Spent__c)), TRUNC(Spent__c, 0) <> Spent__c, MCEILING(Spent__c) > MFLOOR(Spent__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Budget, Completion or Spent breaks the rounding conventions.
